name: 52_week_high
description: Price printed a new 52-week high today.

name: 52_week_low
description: Price printed a new 52-week low today.

name: above_opening_range
description: Price is trading above the first 15-minute opening-range high.

name: above_premarket_high
description: Close above the pre-market session high.

name: above_price_target
description: Current price is above the consensus analyst target.

name: above_session_open
description: Close above today’s session-open price.

name: above_sma_10
description: Price is above the 10-day simple moving average.

name: above_sma_20
description: Price is above the 20-day simple moving average.

name: above_sma_200
description: Price is above the 200-day simple moving average.

name: above_sma_50
description: Price is above the 50-day simple moving average.

name: above_vwap
description: Price is above today’s volume-weighted average price.

name: above_vwap_minute
description: Current price above session VWAP.

name: above_yesterday_close
description: Close above the prior session’s close.

name: above_yesterday_high
description: Close above the prior session’s intraday high.

name: accounts_payable
description: Trade payables to suppliers as of the quarter end.

name: active
description: Ticker is actively traded (not delisted or halted).

name: address_address1
description: Company headquarters street address.

name: address_city
description: Company headquarters city.

name: address_postal_code
description: Company headquarters postal code.

name: address_state
description: Company headquarters state or region.

name: adx_14
description: Average Directional Index (14-period): trend strength from 0 to 100.

name: afterhours_change_pct
description: Percent change from the regular-session close to the most recent after-hours print. Sparse: most equities don't trade after hours, and the value updates only when a print happens.

name: afterhours_price
description: Last after-hours price, if available.

name: afternoon_drift_up
description: Afternoon session net up.

name: analyst_consensus_rating
description: Consensus analyst rating across contributing firms. One of `strong buy`, `buy`, `hold`, `sell`, `strong sell`. NULL for tickers without analyst coverage.

name: analyst_consensus_rating_value
description: Consensus rating as a numeric score on the standard 1–5 scale (1 = strong buy, 5 = strong sell). Lower is more bullish.

name: analyst_consensus_target_price
description: Mean of contributing analysts' 12-month price targets.

name: analyst_count_buy
description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as buy.

name: analyst_count_hold
description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as hold (neutral).

name: analyst_count_sell
description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as sell.

name: analyst_count_strong_buy
description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as strong buy.

name: analyst_count_strong_sell
description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as strong sell.

name: analyst_count_total
description: Total number of contributing firms covering the ticker with any rating. Sum of the five `analyst_count_*` buckets. `well_covered` fires when this is at least 10.

name: analyst_count_with_target
description: Number of contributing firms whose rating includes a published 12-month price target. Always ≤ `analyst_count_total`.

name: analyst_target_price_high
description: Highest single-analyst 12-month price target across contributing firms.

name: analyst_target_price_low
description: Lowest single-analyst 12-month price target across contributing firms.

name: analyst_target_upside_pct
description: Implied upside from the current price to the consensus target, in percent. `(analyst_consensus_target_price - price) / price * 100`. Negative when price is above target. Recomputed every minute, 4 AM to 8 PM ET.

name: approaching_52w_high
description: Price is within 5% of the 52-week high.

name: approaching_52w_low
description: Price is within 5% of the 52-week low.

name: asset_class
description: Asset class of the ticker: stocks, rates, crypto or fx.

name: asset_type
description: Instrument type code. One of: `CS` (common stock), `ETF`, `ADRC`, `PFD`, `WARRANT`, `FUND`, `UNIT`, `SP`, `RIGHT`, `ETS`, `ETV`, `ETN`. Asset class is `asset_class`.

name: assets
description: Total assets on the balance sheet as of the most recently reported quarter.

name: at_20d_high
description: Price is at or above the 20-day high as of the previous close.

name: at_20d_low
description: Price is at or below the 20-day low as of the previous close.

name: at_52w_high
description: Price is at or above the 52-week high as of the previous close.

name: at_52w_low
description: Price is at or below the 52-week low as of the previous close.

name: at_bollinger_lower
description: Price is within 2% of the lower Bollinger band, above or below it.

name: at_bollinger_upper
description: Price is within 2% of the upper Bollinger band, above or below it.

name: at_resistance
description: Price is testing a detected resistance level.

name: at_session_high
description: At today’s intraday session high (within tolerance).

name: at_session_low
description: At today’s intraday session low (within tolerance).

name: at_support
description: Price is testing a detected support level.

name: atr_14
description: 14-day Average True Range.

name: atr_pct
description: ATR(14) as a percent of price. Useful as a volatility filter.

name: avg_volume_10d
description: 10-day trailing average daily volume.

name: avg_volume_30d
description: 30-day trailing average daily volume.

name: basic_average_shares
description: Weighted-average basic shares outstanding for the quarter. Denominator for basic EPS.

name: basic_earnings_per_share
description: Basic EPS for the most-recently reported quarter. Signed.

name: bearish_consensus
description: Consensus analyst rating is `sell` or `strong sell`.

name: below_opening_range
description: Price is trading below the first 15-minute opening-range low.

name: below_premarket_low
description: Close below the pre-market session low.

name: below_price_target
description: Current price is below the consensus analyst target.

name: below_yesterday_low
description: Close below the prior session’s intraday low.

name: beta
description: Trailing beta vs SPY. Null for issuers with insufficient price history.

name: bollinger_b
description: Position within Bollinger bands. 0 = at lower band, 1 = at upper band, >1 = outside.

name: bollinger_lower
description: Lower Bollinger band (20-period, 2σ).

name: bollinger_middle
description: 20-day SMA: the centerline of the Bollinger band, between `bollinger_upper` and `bollinger_lower`.

name: bollinger_squeeze
description: Bollinger band width is under 0.04: volatility has contracted.

name: bollinger_upper
description: Upper Bollinger band (20-period, 2σ).

name: bollinger_width
description: Bollinger band width normalized by the centerline: `(bollinger_upper − bollinger_lower) / bollinger_middle`. A volatility measure; see `bollinger_squeeze` for the compressed state.

name: book_value
description: Trailing-12m book value per share. Computed from `equity_attributable_to_parent / diluted_average_shares`.

name: bounce_off_support
description: Bounced off a detected support level: price tagged the band within three sessions and closed up.

name: branding_icon_url
description: URL of the company's square icon image, or null when none is on file. Request it with your API key (the same Authorization: Bearer header) to get the image bytes (PNG or JPEG) with their Content-Type.

name: branding_logo_url
description: URL of the company's logo image, or null when none is on file. Request it with your API key (the same Authorization: Bearer header) to get the image bytes (SVG when available, else PNG) with their Content-Type.

name: bullish_consensus
description: Consensus analyst rating is `strong buy` or `buy`.

name: buyback_30d
description: Shares outstanding fell more than 1% over the last 30 days.

name: cap_class
description: Market-capitalization tier. One of `nano` (<$50M), `micro` ($50M–$300M), `small` ($300M–$2B), `mid` ($2B–$10B), `large` ($10B–$200B), `mega` (≥$200B) or `unknown` when `market_cap` is null. Updates daily post-close as `market_cap` moves. Preferred over the legacy `nano_cap/micro_cap/small_cap/mid_cap/large_cap/mega_cap` boolean signals (which remain in sync as backward-compat shortcuts).

name: cash_and_short_term_investments
description: Cash and cash equivalents plus short-term investments from the latest reported balance sheet, in USD. When the balance sheet reports no short-term investments, it equals cash_on_hand. In history, dated from the filing, like cash_on_hand.

name: cash_on_hand
description: Cash and cash equivalents from the latest reported balance sheet, in USD. Short-term investments are not included. In history, each value takes effect on the day the company filed it with the SEC; when only a later re-filing date is known, it takes effect 90 days after the quarter ended. When a balance sheet reports exactly zero cash, the value is kept only if the company's own SEC filing also shows zero for that quarter; otherwise it is null. For banks, the SEC cash total: cash and due from banks plus interest-bearing deposits at other banks and the Fed.

name: cash_ratio
description: Cash and cash equivalents divided by current liabilities, from the latest reported balance sheet. Null when current liabilities are not reported. In history, dated from the filing, like cash_on_hand. Null for banks, which report no current liabilities.

name: change_1d_pct
description: Percent change vs `previous_close`, as a whole percent (0.5 = 0.5%, not a fraction). Signed. Percent scale on every read (live, `asof` by date, `asof` by timestamp) since the 2026-09-07 cutover; before it, this signal was `day_change_pct`, a fraction.

name: change_1m_pct
description: Percent change vs. close ~21 trading days ago. Daily; see `change_1w_pct` for note.

name: change_1w_pct
description: Percent change in close vs the close 5 trading days ago. Computed after the close and not updated intraday; for intraday change use `from_open_pct` and `change_1d_pct`.

name: change_1y_pct
description: Percent change vs. close ~252 trading days ago.

name: change_3m_pct
description: Percent change vs. close ~63 trading days ago.

name: change_6m_pct
description: Percent change vs. close ~126 trading days ago.

name: change_ytd_pct
description: Percent change since the last close of the previous calendar year, as a whole percent. A stock listed this year is measured from its first close.

name: cik
description: SEC Central Index Key: the company's identifier in EDGAR filings.

name: composite_figi
description: Composite FIGI: Bloomberg's cross-exchange security identifier.

name: consolidating_15m
description: Last 15 minutes traded in a tight range.

name: consolidation
description: Price is range-bound: the last 5 sessions span less than 5%.

name: cost_of_revenue
description: Cost of goods sold for the quarter.

name: costs_and_expenses
description: Total costs and expenses reported on the income statement (COGS + opex).

name: country
description: Listing locale from the reference vendor, not the issuer's home country. Every US-listed symbol, including ADRs, reports `us`. For where the company is run from and where it is incorporated, use `issuer_country` and `incorporation_country`.

name: currency_name
description: Currency the prices are quoted in (`usd`, `eur`, `gbp`, etc.). Effectively always `usd` for US-listed equities.

name: current_assets
description: Assets expected to be converted to cash or used up within 12 months.

name: current_liabilities
description: Liabilities due within 12 months (accounts payable, short-term debt, accrued expenses).

name: current_ratio
description: Current assets ÷ current liabilities. Short-term liquidity. >1 = able to cover short-term obligations from current assets.

name: day_change
description: Absolute change vs `previous_close`.

name: day_dollar_volume
description: Today’s cumulative dollar volume traded.

name: day_vwap
description: Today’s session volume-weighted average price.

name: days_down
description: Consecutive trading days closing lower than the prior close. Resets to 0 on an up or unchanged close.

name: days_since_52w_high
description: Calendar days since the most recent 52-week high.

name: days_since_52w_low
description: Calendar days since the most recent 52-week low.

name: days_to_cover
description: Short interest divided by 30-day average daily volume. Trader’s "how many days of normal trading to cover all shorts" measure.

name: days_to_earnings
description: Calendar days until next earnings announcement. Negative after report.

name: days_up
description: Consecutive trading days closing higher than the prior close. Resets to 0 on a down or unchanged close.

name: death_cross
description: 50-day SMA crossed below 200-day SMA today.

name: death_regime
description: Long-term downtrend regime: the 50-day SMA is below the 200-day SMA.

name: debt_to_equity
description: Total debt divided by total shareholders' equity. Common leverage ratio; lower = less leveraged.

name: delisted_utc
description: When the symbol was delisted; empty while it is listed.

name: description
description: Business description of the company.

name: diluted_average_shares
description: Weighted-average diluted shares outstanding for the quarter. Denominator for diluted EPS.

name: diluted_eps_ttm
description: Trailing-12m diluted EPS.

name: dilution_30d
description: Shares outstanding rose more than 3% over the last 30 days.

name: dividend
description: Most-recent dividend amount per share.

name: dividend_approaching
description: The ex-dividend date falls within the next 7 days.

name: dividend_date
description: Ex-dividend date of the most recent dividend: own the stock before this date to receive it. The live value and history carry the same date.

name: dividend_frequency
description: Payment frequency: `quarterly`, `monthly`, `semiannual`, `annual`.

name: dividend_payout_ratio
description: Trailing 12-month dividends per share divided by trailing diluted EPS (0.25 = a quarter of earnings paid out). Null when EPS is zero, negative or missing. Empty on warrants and rights.

name: dividend_ttm
description: Dividends per share paid over the trailing 12 months, specials included. Null when nothing went ex-dividend in that window.

name: dividend_yield
description: Forward dividend yield as a fraction (0.025 = 2.5%). Null for companies that pay none.

name: earnings_approaching
description: Earnings within 3 days.

name: earnings_beat_streak
description: Consecutive quarters the company has beaten consensus EPS estimates. Resets to 0 on a miss.

name: earnings_date
description: Next earnings announcement date. Where the company has not published one, the date is projected from its own reporting history and earnings_date_projected is true.

name: earnings_date_projected
description: True when earnings_date is our projection from the company's own reporting history rather than a published calendar date.

name: earnings_fiscal_quarter
description: End date of the fiscal quarter the next earnings report covers (e.g. 2026-10-31). Fiscal, not calendar: it follows the company's own fiscal year.

name: earnings_growth_yoy_pct
description: Year-over-year EPS growth percent from the most recently reported quarter vs. the same quarter prior year. Signed; positive = growth.

name: earnings_next_week
description: Next earnings announcement is 8 to 14 days out.

name: earnings_published
description: Earnings report date has passed (next earnings date is in the past).

name: earnings_report_time
description: When in the trading day the next earnings will be reported. One of `BMO` (before market open), `AMC` (after market close), `DMH` (during market hours).

name: earnings_this_week
description: Earnings announcement scheduled in the next 7 days.

name: earnings_today
description: Earnings reported today.

name: earnings_tomorrow
description: Earnings reported in 1 calendar day. Pair with `earnings_report_time` to know BMO vs. AMC.

name: ebitda
description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (TTM).

name: ema_12
description: 12-day EMA. Fast-side input of canonical MACD (`macd = ema_12 − ema_26`).

name: ema_21
description: 21-day EMA. Often paired with `ema_9` for short-trend bias; also serves as a dynamic-support reference.

name: ema_26
description: 26-day EMA. Slow-side input of canonical MACD (`macd = ema_12 − ema_26`).

name: ema_9
description: 9-day exponential moving average of close. Most-recent-weighted; reacts faster than the same-period SMA. Commonly paired with `ema_21` for short-trend bias.

name: enterprise_value
description: Market cap + total debt − cash.

name: eps
description: Earnings per share (trailing twelve months).

name: eps_diluted_fy
description: Diluted EPS for the last reported fiscal year.

name: eps_estimate_revision_down_30d
description: Count of analysts who lowered their next-quarter EPS estimate in the last 30 days.

name: eps_estimate_revision_up_30d
description: Count of analysts who raised their next-quarter EPS estimate in the last 30 days. A positive read on forward sentiment momentum.

name: equity
description: Total shareholders' equity.

name: equity_attributable_to_noncontrolling_interest
description: Equity attributable to minority shareholders of consolidated subsidiaries. Usually 0 for non-conglomerates.

name: equity_attributable_to_parent
description: Equity attributable to the parent entity's shareholders (excludes minority interest).

name: estimate_revised_down
description: At least one analyst lowered their next-quarter EPS estimate in the last 30 days.

name: estimate_revised_up
description: At least one analyst raised their next-quarter EPS estimate in the last 30 days.

name: etf_dividend_yield
description: Dividend yield as reported by the fund, as a fraction. ETFs only.

name: etf_expense_ratio
description: Net expense ratio as a fraction (0.0009 = 0.09% a year). ETFs only.

name: etf_holders
description: ETFs that hold this ticker, ordered by the ticker's weight within each (the reverse of ETF holdings). Filter with array operators in /v2/scan, e.g. `'SPY' = ANY(etf_holders)` to find SPY constituents. Refreshed nightly post-close.

name: etf_inception_date
description: Date the fund launched. ETFs only.

name: etf_leveraged
description: True for leveraged and inverse-leveraged funds. ETFs only.

name: etf_net_assets
description: Fund net assets (assets under management) in USD. ETFs only.

name: etf_turnover
description: Portfolio turnover as a fraction per year (0.03 = 3%). ETFs only.

name: ev_to_ebitda
description: `enterprise_value` ÷ `ebitda`. Capital-structure-neutral profitability multiple.

name: ev_to_sales
description: `enterprise_value` ÷ `revenue_ttm`. Capital-structure-neutral revenue multiple.

name: ex_dividend_date
description: The nearest announced ex-dividend date; once it passes with no new one announced, the most recent one.

name: exchange
description: Primary listing exchange as a readable name, e.g. `NASDAQ`, `NYSE`, `NYSE Arca`, `Cboe BZX`, `NYSE American`, `OTC Markets`. See `exchange_mic` for the ISO 10383 code. Null for a small number of delisted and edge-case names.

name: exchange_mic
description: Primary listing exchange as an ISO 10383 **MIC code**: `XNAS` = NASDAQ, `XNYS` = NYSE, `ARCX` = NYSE Arca, `BATS` = Cboe BZX, `XASE` = NYSE American. The `?exchange=` filter accepts either this code or the human name.

name: expanded_hourly_range
description: This hour’s range is unusually wide.

name: fiscal_year_end_month
description: Month the company's fiscal year ends, 1-12, from its SEC filings.

name: fixed_assets
description: Property, plant and equipment (PP&E), net of accumulated depreciation.

name: float_effective_date
description: As-of date for the current float-shares figure.

name: float_shares
description: Public float (shares available to trade).

name: forward_pe
description: Forward price-to-earnings ratio using next-12m consensus EPS. Lower = cheaper on forward basis.

name: free_cash_flow
description: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. Cash the business generates above what it needs to maintain operations.

name: free_float_pct
description: Percent of shares outstanding actually available for trading (excludes insider / restricted holdings).

name: from_52w_high_pct
description: Percent distance from the 52-week high, as a whole percent. Signed: negative below the high (−27 = 27% under it), 0 at it, positive only on a new high before the window updates. Use the `at_52w_high` boolean to test highs. Was `pct_from_52w_high` as a fraction before the 2026-09-07 cutover.

name: from_52w_low_pct
description: Percent distance above the 52-week low, as a whole percent (22 = 22% above it). Signed; ≥ 0 except at a new low before the window updates. Use the `at_52w_low` boolean to test lows.

name: from_open_pct
description: Intraday: percent change from today's session open to the current price. Resets each session.

name: from_sma_10_pct
description: Percent difference between the current price and `sma_10`. Positive = above the average, negative = below. Continuous version of the `above_sma_10` boolean.

name: from_sma_100_pct
description: Percent difference between the current price and `sma_100`. Negative when price is below the average.

name: from_sma_20_pct
description: Percent difference between the current price and `sma_20`. Continuous version of the `above_sma_20` boolean.

name: from_sma_200_pct
description: Percent distance from the 200-day SMA. Negative when price is below the average.

name: from_sma_50_pct
description: Percent distance from the 50-day SMA. Negative when price is below the average.

name: from_vwap_pct
description: Percent distance of the price from today's VWAP.

name: fundamentals_basis
description: 'annual' where the company's fundamentals come from a yearly SEC report (listed ADRs, foreign filers reporting in another currency); empty otherwise.

name: fy_period_end
description: End date of the fiscal year the _fy fields describe.

name: gap_down
description: Today opened 3%+ below prior close.

name: gap_down_extreme
description: Today opened 10%+ below prior close.

name: gap_filled_today
description: Today’s opening gap was closed by an intraday move.

name: gap_pct
description: Percent change of `session_open` vs `previous_close`. One value per session.

name: gap_up
description: Today opened 3%+ above prior close.

name: gap_up_extreme
description: Today opened 10%+ above prior close.

name: golden_cross
description: 50-day SMA crossed above 200-day SMA today.

name: golden_regime
description: Long-term uptrend regime: the 50-day SMA is above the 200-day SMA.

name: gross_margin
description: `gross_profit / revenues` for the quarter.

name: gross_profit
description: `revenues − cost_of_revenue` for the quarter.

name: gross_profit_ttm
description: Trailing-12m gross profit.

name: held_above_vwap_30m
description: Price has stayed above session VWAP without dipping for at least 30 minutes.

name: held_below_vwap_30m
description: Price has stayed below session VWAP without lifting for at least 30 minutes.

name: high_20d
description: Highest trade in the trailing 20 trading days.

name: high_20d_eod
description: Highest close over the last 20 trading sessions. Close-basis. For the intraday-wick variant use `at_20d_high`.

name: high_52w
description: Highest trade in the trailing 52 weeks (live, includes today).

name: high_52w_date
description: Date the trailing-52-week high was set. Useful for "fresh 52w highs in the last 30 days" scans.

name: high_52w_eod
description: Highest close over the trailing 52 weeks. The `_eod` distinguishes from the canonical intraday `52_week_high` (which captures wicks).

name: high_5d
description: Highest intraday high over the last 5 trading sessions, inclusive of the current session.

name: high_5d_eod
description: Highest close over the last 5 trading sessions. Close basis, no intraday highs; `high_5d` includes them.

name: high_beta
description: Beta above 2.0: moves much more than the market.

name: high_dividend_yield
description: Dividend yield above 4%.

name: high_earnings_estimate
description: Consensus next-quarter EPS estimate exceeds an absolute $1.00 per share threshold.

name: high_margin
description: Trailing-twelve-month profit margin is above 20%.

name: high_short_interest
description: More than 20% of the float is sold short.

name: high_volume_alert
description: Volume is running well above its 10-day average. Live: this minute traded more than 5x a typical minute. In daily history: the day traded at least 2x its 10-day average.

name: highly_relevant_news_count
description: How many articles in the last 7 days scored this name's relevance at 0.6 or higher.

name: homepage_url
description: Company homepage URL.

name: hourly_reversal_bearish
description: Higher high, lower close than the prior hour.

name: hourly_reversal_bullish
description: Lower low, higher close than the prior hour.

name: illiquid
description: Thinly traded: 10-day average volume is under 100k shares.

name: in_downtrend
description: Price is below its 50-day average and the 50-day average is below the 200-day.

name: in_opening_range
description: Price is inside the first-hour high/low range.

name: in_uptrend
description: Price is above its 50-day average and the 50-day average is above the 200-day.

name: inactive_at
description: When the ticker was marked inactive.

name: inactive_reason
description: Why the ticker was marked inactive (e.g. delisted, stale data).

name: income_loss_from_continuing_operations_after_tax
description: After-tax income from continuing operations for the quarter.

name: income_loss_from_continuing_operations_before_tax
description: Pre-tax income from continuing operations for the quarter.

name: income_tax_expense_benefit
description: Income tax expense (positive) or benefit (negative) for the quarter.

name: incorporation_country
description: Where the issuer is legally incorporated, as a lower-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. It comes from the state or country of incorporation in its SEC filings, with US states mapped to `us`: `ky` for Huize (Cayman-incorporated, run from China), `us` for Apple. Null when the symbol has no SEC filer identifier. Pair with `issuer_country` to tell an offshore-incorporated operator from a domestic one.

name: industry
description: Industry within the sector.

name: insider_buy_value_90d
description: Value of open-market insider purchases over the last 90 days, USD; 0 when none.

name: insider_buyers_90d
description: Number of different insiders who bought on the open market in the last 90 days.

name: insider_c_suite_buy
description: A top officer (CEO, CFO, COO, President or Chair) or a director bought shares on the open market in the last 7 days.

name: insider_c_suite_sell
description: A top officer (CEO, CFO, COO, President or Chair) or a director sold shares on the open market in the last 7 days.

name: insider_cluster_buy
description: Two or more different insiders bought shares on the open market in the last 14 days.

name: insider_net_value_90d
description: Open-market insider purchases minus sales over the last 90 days, USD; negative means net selling.

name: insider_sell_value_90d
description: Value of open-market insider sales over the last 90 days, USD; 0 when none.

name: insiders_pct
description: Percent of shares held by company insiders (executives, directors, founders).

name: institutions_pct
description: Percent of shares held by institutional investors (mutual funds, ETFs, pensions).

name: inventory
description: Inventory on hand. NULL for service and financial companies that don't carry inventory.

name: ipo_date
description: Date of the company's IPO, when known.

name: ipo_in_7d
description: An expected IPO listing date falls within the next 7 days.

name: issuer_country
description: Where the company is run from: the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (lower-case) of the issuer's business address in its SEC filings. `cn` for Huize (HUIZ), `us` for Apple. Null when the symbol has no SEC filer identifier (most ETFs and non-SEC filers). Distinct from `country`, which is the listing locale, and from `incorporation_country`, the legal domicile.

name: large_cap
description: Market cap between $10B and $200B.

name: last_20d_high_date
description: Date the trailing-20-day high was set.

name: last_20d_low_date
description: Date the trailing-20-day low was set.

name: last_earnings_date
description: Date of the company's most recent earnings report.

name: last_earnings_surprise
description: `last_reported_eps − last_eps_estimate`. Signed; positive = beat.

name: last_earnings_surprise_pct
description: Reported EPS versus the consensus estimate for the same quarter, as a percent of the estimate. Reported EPS can include one-time items that consensus excludes, so a large surprise is not always an operating beat.

name: last_eps_estimate
description: Consensus EPS estimate going into the most recent earnings announcement.

name: last_fiscal_quarter_end
description: End date of the fiscal quarter covered by the most recent earnings report.

name: last_hour_rally
description: Final hour of session net up.

name: last_hour_selloff
description: Final hour of session net down.

name: last_insider_trade_action
description: buy or sell: the side of the latest day of open-market insider trades.

name: last_insider_trade_date
description: Date of the latest open-market insider purchase or sale.

name: last_insider_trade_value
description: Total value of that day's insider trades on that side, USD.

name: last_rating_action
description: Action taken in the most recent rating change. Common values: `upgrades`, `downgrades`, `initiates_coverage_on`, `maintains`, `reiterates`, `assumes`, `reinstates`, `suspends`.

name: last_rating_date
description: Date of the most recent rating action across all firms covering the ticker.

name: last_rating_firm
description: Name of the firm that issued the most recent rating action.

name: last_reported_eps
description: EPS as reported in the most recent earnings announcement, including one-time items.

name: last_split_date
description: Date of the latest split the company has made.

name: last_split_ratio
description: Ratio of the latest split: 4 = 4-for-1, 0.125 = 1-for-8 reverse.

name: latest_news_at
description: Publish time of the newest article that mentions the ticker.

name: leadership
description: The current C-suite as a list of names and titles, from SEC insider filings.

name: liabilities
description: Total liabilities on the balance sheet.

name: liabilities_and_equity
description: Total liabilities plus total equity. Equals `assets` by the balance-sheet identity, so it is mostly useful as a check.

name: list_date
description: Date the symbol was first listed on its exchange.

name: long_term_debt
description: Long-term debt from the most recent reported balance sheet, including capital-lease obligations, in USD. Null when the issuer does not break it out from noncurrent liabilities.

name: loss_estimate
description: Analyst consensus expects negative EPS for the upcoming report.

name: low_20d
description: Lowest trade in the trailing 20 trading days.

name: low_20d_eod
description: Lowest close over the last 20 trading sessions. Close-basis.

name: low_52w
description: Lowest trade in the trailing 52 weeks (live, includes today).

name: low_52w_date
description: Date the trailing-52-week low was set.

name: low_52w_eod
description: Lowest close over the trailing 52 weeks.

name: low_5d
description: Lowest intraday low over the last 5 trading sessions, inclusive of the current session.

name: low_5d_eod
description: Lowest close over the last 5 trading sessions. Close-basis.

name: low_beta
description: Beta below 0.5: moves much less than the market.

name: low_float
description: Public float under 50 million shares.

name: low_volume_regime
description: In a sustained quiet stretch: the last 30 minutes traded at or below 30% of this name's usual volume for this time of day.

name: macd_above_signal
description: MACD line is above its signal line.

name: macd_below_signal
description: MACD line is below its signal line.

name: macd_histogram
description: MACD line minus signal. Positive when bullish, negative when bearish.

name: macd_line
description: MACD line (12-EMA minus 26-EMA).

name: macd_signal
description: MACD signal line (9-EMA of MACD line).

name: market_cap
description: Market capitalization. Updated daily; intraday change derived from `price` × `shares_outstanding`.

name: mega_cap
description: Market cap above $200B.

name: micro_cap
description: Market cap between $50M and $300M.

name: microspike_down
description: Single 1-minute candle return ≤ −1%.

name: microspike_up
description: Single 1-minute candle return ≥ +1%.

name: mid_cap
description: Market cap between $2B and $10B.

name: min_close
description: Current minute bar’s most-recent close (last print).

name: min_day_accumulated_dollar_volume
description: Today’s cumulative dollar volume across the session so far.

name: min_day_accumulated_volume
description: Today’s cumulative shares traded across the session so far (4 AM ET onward).

name: min_dollar_volume
description: Current minute bar’s dollar volume (close × volume approximation).

name: min_high
description: Current minute bar’s running high.

name: min_low
description: Current minute bar’s running low.

name: min_open
description: Current minute bar’s open. Updates every minute, 4 AM to 8 PM ET.

name: min_trade_count
description: Current minute bar’s number of trades.

name: min_volume
description: Current minute bar’s accumulated shares traded.

name: min_vwap
description: Current minute bar’s volume-weighted average price.

name: minus_di
description: -DI (14-period): the bearish directional-movement component of the ADX system.

name: momentum_down
description: Sustained downward momentum on the daily bars.

name: momentum_exhaustion_down
description: Downward momentum showing signs of exhaustion.

name: momentum_exhaustion_up
description: Upward momentum showing signs of exhaustion.

name: momentum_strong_down
description: Strong downward momentum across multiple measures.

name: momentum_strong_up
description: Strong upward momentum across multiple measures.

name: momentum_up
description: Sustained upward momentum on the daily bars.

name: morning_strength
description: First two hours of session net positive.

name: name
description: Company or asset display name.

name: nano_cap
description: Market cap below $50M.

name: narrow_hourly_range
description: This hour’s range is unusually narrow.

name: net_cash_flow
description: Period change in cash: operating plus investing plus financing cash flow.

name: net_cash_flow_continuing
description: Total cash flow excluding discontinued operations. Populated only for companies winding down discontinued operations.

name: net_cash_flow_from_financing_activities
description: Net cash from financing (debt, dividends, buybacks).

name: net_cash_flow_from_financing_activities_continuing
description: Financing cash flow excluding discontinued operations.

name: net_cash_flow_from_investing_activities
description: Net cash from investing activities (capex, acquisitions). Negative for net spend.

name: net_cash_flow_from_investing_activities_continuing
description: Investing cash flow excluding discontinued operations.

name: net_cash_flow_from_operating_activities
description: Net cash from operations for the quarter.

name: net_cash_flow_from_operating_activities_continuing
description: Same as `net_cash_flow_from_operating_activities` but excludes discontinued operations.

name: net_income_fy
description: Net income for the last reported fiscal year, USD.

name: net_income_loss
description: Bottom-line net income/loss for the quarter. Signed.

name: net_income_loss_attributable_to_noncontrolling_interest
description: Portion of net income attributable to minority owners of consolidated subsidiaries. Usually 0 for non-conglomerates.

name: net_income_loss_attributable_to_parent
description: Net income attributable to the parent entity (excludes noncontrolling interest).

name: net_income_loss_available_to_common_stockholders_basic
description: Net income available to common shareholders: the numerator of basic EPS.

name: news_sentiment_volatility
description: How much the news sentiment about this name has been swinging over the last 7 days.

name: news_volume
description: Today's news flow compared with normal: 1.0 is a typical day, 2.0 is twice normal. It counts articles about this name in the last 24 hours (relevance 0.6 or higher) and divides by its median daily count over the prior 30 days (the median is never below 1). Null when there are no such articles in the last 24 hours.

name: news_volume_weighted_sentiment
description: The sentiment of today's news, scaled by how unusual the volume is. It is the relevance-weighted average sentiment of the last 24 hours' scored articles (relevance 0.6 or higher), times `tanh(max(0, news_volume − 1) / 1.5)`. A normal or quiet day reads 0; the multiplier is 0.58 at twice normal volume and 0.87 at three times. Ranges from −1 to 1; null when there are no such articles.

name: next_eps_estimate
description: Consensus EPS estimate for the next reported quarter: a weighted average across contributing analysts.

name: next_eps_estimate_high
description: Highest single-analyst EPS estimate for the next reported quarter.

name: next_eps_estimate_low
description: Lowest single-analyst EPS estimate for the next reported quarter.

name: next_revenue_estimate
description: Wall Street consensus revenue estimate (USD, full dollars) for the next reported quarter.

name: noncurrent_assets
description: Long-lived assets: property, plant and equipment, intangibles, long-term investments.

name: noncurrent_liabilities
description: Liabilities due beyond 12 months: long-term debt, deferred taxes, pension obligations.

name: nonoperating_income_loss
description: Non-operating income/loss (interest income, gains/losses on investments, etc.) for the quarter. Signed.

name: opening_drive_down
description: First 5 minutes of session down < −0.5%.

name: opening_drive_up
description: First 5 minutes of session up > +0.5%.

name: operating_expenses
description: Sum of operating costs reported on the income statement for the quarter (excludes COGS).

name: operating_income_loss
description: Operating income or loss for the quarter. Signed.

name: operating_margin
description: `operating_income_loss / revenues` for the quarter.

name: operating_margin_ttm
description: Trailing-12m operating margin.

name: other_current_assets
description: Current assets not separately broken out (prepaid expenses, short-term receivables, etc.).

name: other_current_liabilities
description: Current liabilities not separately broken out.

name: other_noncurrent_assets
description: Non-current assets not separately broken out (intangibles, deferred tax assets, etc.).

name: pe_ratio
description: Price-to-earnings ratio (trailing twelve months). Null for unprofitable issuers.

name: peg_ratio
description: PE ratio divided by EPS growth rate. Sparse: computed only for tickers with positive earnings growth and analyst coverage.

name: pending_ipo
description: The ticker is in the IPO calendar but has not started trading.

name: phone_number
description: Company contact phone number.

name: plus_di
description: +DI (14-period): the bullish directional-movement component of the ADX system.

name: position_in_52w_range_pct
description: Where the live price sits in the 52-week range, 0–100. 0 = at low, 100 = at high.

name: pre_close_drift_down
description: Last 10 minutes before close net down.

name: pre_close_drift_up
description: Last 10 minutes before close net up.

name: pre_earnings_drift
description: Stock has moved 5% or more (absolute) over the trailing week, with earnings within 7 days.

name: premarket_change_pct
description: Pre-market: percent change from the previous close to the latest pre-market trade. Resets at the session boundary.

name: premarket_price
description: Last premarket price, if available.

name: prev_day_high
description: Previous trading day’s session high.

name: prev_day_low
description: Previous trading day’s session low.

name: prev_day_open
description: Previous trading day’s official open.

name: prev_day_volume
description: Previous trading day’s total volume (raw shares).

name: prev_day_vwap
description: Previous trading day’s session VWAP.

name: previous_close
description: Official prior-session close.

name: price
description: Current price: the newest source we hold for the ticker, in a fixed order; price_source says which one.

name: price_asof
description: The time of the data behind the price.

name: price_down_3pct
description: Intraday move of -3% or worse vs prior close.

name: price_source
description: Where the price came from.

name: price_to_book
description: Current price ÷ `book_value`. Common value-investing metric.

name: price_to_cash_flow
description: Current price ÷ operating cash flow per share. Less manipulable than P/E.

name: price_to_free_cash_flow
description: Current price ÷ `free_cash_flow` per share. Strictest cash-based valuation.

name: price_to_sales
description: Current price ÷ `revenue_per_share_ttm`. Often used when companies have no earnings.

name: price_up_3pct
description: Intraday move of 3%+ vs prior close.

name: profit_margin
description: Net income ÷ revenue. Quarterly.

name: profit_margin_ttm
description: Trailing-12m profit margin.

name: profitable
description: Most-recently-reported quarter had positive net income.

name: profitable_estimate
description: Analyst consensus expects positive EPS for the upcoming report.

name: pullback
description: Pullback to the 20-day moving average within an uptrend.

name: quick_ratio
description: (Current assets − inventory) ÷ current liabilities. A stricter liquidity ratio than the current ratio, since it leaves out inventory.

name: quiet_minute
description: A sustained quiet stretch: 10-minute average volume well below the recent baseline.

name: range_break_15m_down
description: Broke below the prior 15-minute low.

name: range_break_15m_up
description: Broke above the prior 15-minute high.

name: range_expansion
description: Today's true range is more than 2 × ATR(14), on volume. Direction-agnostic.

name: rapid_move_down_5m
description: Price down more than −0.5% in the last 5 minutes.

name: rapid_move_up_5m
description: Price up more than +0.5% in the last 5 minutes.

name: ratios_asof
description: Date of the financial data behind the valuation ratios (P/E, price-to-book, EV/EBITDA and the rest). Compare with price_asof to see how current a ratio is.

name: recent_downgrade
description: At least one analyst downgraded the ticker in the last 7 days.

name: recent_initiation
description: At least one analyst initiated coverage in the last 7 days.

name: recent_news_count
description: How many articles mentioned this name in the last 7 days, at any relevance.

name: recent_target_lower
description: At least one analyst lowered their price target in the last 7 days.

name: recent_target_raise
description: At least one analyst raised their price target in the last 7 days.

name: recent_upgrade
description: At least one analyst upgraded the ticker in the last 7 days.

name: recently_ipoed
description: The company listed within the last 90 days.

name: recently_reported_earnings
description: Reported earnings within the last 5 days.

name: relative_volume
description: Today's volume relative to the average of the 10 sessions before today. 2.0 means twice normal.

name: repeated_test_of_high
description: Price has tested today's session high three or more times without breaking it.

name: repeated_test_of_low
description: Price has tested today's session low three or more times without breaking it.

name: reporting_currency
description: The currency the company's SEC figures were reported in; every figure we serve is in USD.

name: research_and_development
description: R&D spend for the quarter. NULL for companies that don't report R&D as a line item.

name: return_on_assets
description: Net income ÷ total assets. Quarterly figure.

name: return_on_assets_ttm
description: Trailing-12m return on assets.

name: return_on_equity
description: Net income ÷ shareholders' equity. Quarterly figure.

name: return_on_equity_ttm
description: Trailing-12m return on equity.

name: revenue_by_geography
description: Latest published revenue by region, from the company's SEC filings.

name: revenue_by_product
description: Latest published revenue by product or service line, from the company's SEC filings.

name: revenue_by_segment
description: Latest published revenue by business segment, from the company's SEC filings.

name: revenue_fy
description: Revenue for the last reported fiscal year, USD.

name: revenue_growth_yoy_pct
description: Year-over-year revenue growth: most-recent quarter vs same quarter prior year. Signed; positive = growth.

name: revenue_growth_yoy_quarterly_pct
description: YoY quarterly revenue growth. Signed.

name: revenue_per_share_ttm
description: Trailing-12m revenue divided by diluted shares outstanding. USD per share.

name: revenue_ttm
description: Trailing-twelve-month revenue: the sum of the four most recent fiscal quarters filed by that day.

name: revenues
description: Total revenue for the most-recently reported quarter, from filed income statements.

name: round_lot
description: Standard trading lot size for the symbol.

name: rsi_14
description: Relative Strength Index, 14-period. Range 0–100.

name: rsi_7
description: Relative Strength Index over 7 periods - a faster, more sensitive RSI. Range 0-100.

name: rsi_overbought
description: RSI(14) is in overbought territory.

name: rsi_oversold
description: RSI(14) is in oversold territory.

name: sector
description: Sector. One of: Technology, Healthcare, Financial Services, Industrials, Consumer Cyclical, Consumer Defensive, Basic Materials, Real Estate, Communication Services, Energy, Utilities.

name: selling_general_and_administrative_expenses
description: SG&A for the quarter.

name: session_high
description: Highest trade so far today.

name: session_low
description: Lowest trade so far today.

name: session_open
description: Today’s opening print.

name: share_class_figi
description: Share-class FIGI: Bloomberg's identifier for this specific share class.

name: shares_outstanding
description: Total shares outstanding.

name: short_float_pct
description: Short interest as a percent of the free float. 10 = 10% of float is short.

name: short_interest
description: Raw shares-shorted count as last reported (FINRA bi-monthly). Pair with `short_interest_settlement_date` (profile.ts) for the as-of date.

name: short_interest_settlement_date
description: Settlement date of the most recent short-interest report.

name: short_volume_ratio
description: Share of the day's volume executed as short sales (0–1).

name: short_volume_spike
description: More than 60% of the day's volume was executed as short sales.

name: sic_code
description: SIC code: the SEC's Standard Industrial Classification for the company's industry.

name: sic_description
description: Plain-text label for the company's SIC industry code.

name: sma_10
description: 10-day simple moving average.

name: sma_10_crossed_above_50_today
description: The 10-day SMA crossed above the 50-day SMA today.

name: sma_10_crossed_below_50_today
description: The 10-day SMA crossed below the 50-day SMA today.

name: sma_100
description: 100-day simple moving average of close. Between `sma_50` and `sma_200` in speed.

name: sma_20
description: 20-day simple moving average.

name: sma_200
description: 200-day simple moving average.

name: sma_50
description: 50-day simple moving average.

name: small_cap
description: Market cap between $300M and $2B.

name: split_recent
description: A stock split occurred in the last 7 days or is scheduled within 14 days.

name: sticky_breakout
description: On from the moment price makes a 52-week high until the nightly reset.

name: stochastic_d
description: Stochastic oscillator %D: 3-period smoothing of %K.

name: stochastic_k
description: Stochastic oscillator %K: where price sits within its recent high-low range, 0-100.

name: target_downside_above_10pct
description: Current price is more than 10% above the consensus price target.

name: target_upside_above_10pct
description: Consensus price target implies more than 10% upside from the current price.

name: target_upside_above_25pct
description: Consensus price target implies more than 25% upside from the current price.

name: tested_session_high_recent
description: Price touched today’s session high within the last 5 minutes.

name: tested_session_low_recent
description: Price touched today’s session low within the last 5 minutes.

name: three_down_hours
description: Three consecutive lower hourly closes.

name: three_up_hours
description: Three consecutive higher hourly closes.

name: ticker_category
description: Sub-class within an asset class, e.g. treasury_curve or policy_rate.

name: ticker_root
description: Root symbol: the base ticker without class or suffix modifiers.

name: top_gainer
description: Among the session's top 20 gainers.

name: top_loser
description: Among the session's top 20 losers.

name: total_debt
description: Total debt from the latest reported balance sheet, in USD. It covers short-term borrowings and the current portion of long-term debt, plus long-term debt including capital-lease obligations. In history, dated from the filing, like cash_on_hand.

name: total_employees
description: Number of full-time employees as last reported. Useful for size-based filters ("small-cap by employee count").

name: trend_long
description: Long-term trend classification from `sma_200` slope. One of `uptrend`, `downtrend`, `sideways`.

name: trend_medium
description: Medium-term trend classification from `sma_50` slope. One of `uptrend`, `downtrend`, `sideways`.

name: trend_reversal_bearish_today
description: Trend flipped from up to down today.

name: trend_reversal_bullish_today
description: Trend flipped from down to up today.

name: trend_short
description: Short-term trend classification from short-MA slope. One of `uptrend`, `downtrend`, `sideways`.

name: ultra_low_float
description: Float below 5M shares.

name: value_stock
description: Trades at a value-style P/E.

name: volume_burst_3x
description: Current minute volume ≥ 3× recent average.

name: volume_burst_5x
description: Current minute volume ≥ 5× recent average.

name: volume_change_vs_avg
description: Today's volume relative to `avg_volume_10d`, the 10-session average that includes today. For a comparison against prior sessions only, use `relative_volume`.

name: volume_today
description: Shares traded so far today.

name: volume_trend_5d
description: Slope of daily volume regressed over the last 5 trading days. Positive = building, negative = drying.

name: vwap
description: Daily volume-weighted average price from market open through the most recent print. Updates intraday with each new tick.

name: vwap_cross_down
description: Crossed below session VWAP this minute.

name: vwap_cross_up
description: Crossed above session VWAP this minute.

name: vwap_lower_band
description: Lower VWAP band: VWAP minus one standard deviation of the last 20 daily closes.

name: vwap_upper_band
description: Upper VWAP band: VWAP plus one standard deviation of the last 20 daily closes.

name: weighted_shares_outstanding
description: Weighted shares outstanding from the latest 10-Q / 10-K. Used by `market_cap = price × weighted_shares_outstanding`.

name: well_covered
description: Ten or more analyst firms cover the ticker.
